caption: The drawing displays a symmetrical, geometric quilt-like pattern on a rectangular canvas with a cream-colored background. Its central feature is a large, eight-pointed star composed of repeating, small diamond shapes arranged concentrically in colors including red, yellow, blue, green, black, and white. Each point of the star extends outwards and is filled with a similar pattern of colored diamonds. Surrounding the star are four cream-colored corner sections, each filled with a swirling, leafy black vine accented by small red flowers and containing a green bird. The entire composition is framed by a border featuring an interlacing vine with red, pink, and blue flowers. The lower left corner is annotated with measurements, and the lower right corner is signed with the name "Mary Brown."
title: Patchwork and Applique Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
